<h2>Validate the Active Configuration Profile Selection</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Checks that the active profile is explicitly authorized for a runner.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_config_profile_selection(
  vec_allowed_roles = base::c("main", "smoke"),
  vec_allowed_statuses = "active",
  file = here::here("config.yml")
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="vec_allowed_roles">vec_allowed_roles</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of profile roles authorized by the caller.
Production runners should retain the default 'c(&quot;main&quot;, &quot;smoke&quot;)'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_allowed_statuses">vec_allowed_statuses</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of profile statuses authorized by the caller.
Production runners should retain the default '&quot;active&quot;'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="file">file</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the generated YAML configuration file.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Base and archived profiles are never executable. Main and smoke profiles
must also declare 'selectable: true'. Dedicated reference or one-time
runners may explicitly authorize their role and status.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>The validated '_profile' metadata, invisibly.
</p>

</main>
